name: rolling-number
title: Rolling number
description: A number whose changed digits roll to their new values one after another, left to right, on tabular figures so the width never jumps, with a chip for the change: up in green and down in red, or the other way round for costs. The wheels turn the way the number moved and keep going past 9, a roll cut short carries on from where it is, and the final value is read out once. Two sizes, and any currency or unit through format.
